# NEXUS CORE

> Free AI-built gold (XAUUSD) game plan: key zones, scenarios and the level that proves the view wrong — refreshed before the Asia, London and New York sessions, every plan graded in public.

NEXUS CORE AI publishes a free, AI-built trading plan for gold (XAUUSD) three times each trading day: before the Asia session (07:00 GMT+7), before London (13:45 GMT+7) and before New York (19:30 GMT+7). Each plan gives the bias, the main zone, targets, the level that invalidates the view, scenarios with rough probabilities, and the economic calendar. Every plan is graded in public on 15-minute candles after it expires — wins, losses and misses all stay on the record. Analysis only, not financial advice.

## Latest plan (2026-11-13, Pre-London update, updated 2026-11-13 13:52 GMT+7)

- Permanent page: https://nexuscore.trade/en/plan/2026-11-13-london/
- Bias: TWO-WAY · leaning SELL
- Summary: Two-way, leaning SELL on rallies into 3907.3–3925; PPI next, pivots 3852.6 / 3948.8
- Main zone: SELL 3907.3–3914
- Target T1: 3872.2
- Target T2: 3852.6
- Target T3: 3838.1
- Expected range: 3870–3925
- View is wrong if: Sell side fails on an M15 close above 3948.8 with the next candle holding above → bias flips to buy. Bounce side fails on an M15 close below 3852.6 → further drop to 3838.1 / 3764.7.
- Main scenario (~60%, SELL): Main: before PPI price ranges 3870–3925 and rallies into 3907.3–3925 get sold. Hot PPI (gold-negative): an M15 close below 3852.6 → drop to 3838.1, then 3764.7.
- Alternate scenario (~40%, BUY): Alternative: soft or in-line PPI, M15 closes above 3925 and then above 3948.8 → bias flips to buy, rally to 3965, then the 3980–3991 area.
